title: Home attrition test written guide: jar with lid, sugar cubes
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y7 lesson 16 (Home attrition test written guide: jar with lid, sugar cubes (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 16: How rivers shape the land: erosion, transport, deposition. Read it all first; an adult knows what you are doing.

practical.aim: To model attrition: how rocks become rounder and smaller
equipment: A plastic jar with a lid
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Tidy up and wash your hands
method: Count 10 sugar cubes and note their shape
Put them in the jar with a little water and close the lid
Look at the shape and the cloudy water
Shake again for 2, then 3 minutes and record each time
Explain how rivers make rocks rounder downstream

questions.q: Big question: how can water cut through solid rock?
questions.a: Hydraulic action, abrasion by its load and solution wear rock away over a very long time
